929.short: Ethereal Flicker: each activation, 11+ on d20 -> Ethereal trait until its next activation (cannot carry treasure while ethereal, drops any carried; also Immune to Non-magical weapons while ethereal)

93.short: Hammerhand: always armed with a magical hand weapon; cannot carry a 2-handed weapon, shield, bow, or crossbow

931.short: Curse of Immortality: must reroll any "Dead" Survival result; each time it does, permanent -1 to every stat and -6 levels (if leveled)

932.short: Undead Hands: no weapons/shields (never unarmed); Energy Drain and Magic Attacks traits

933.short: Massively Unstable Portal: natural 1 for initiative while on the table -> place an uncontrolled minor demon 3d6" away in a random direction

934.short: Burst of Quickness: each activation, 16+ on d20 -> +1 action (max 3 total)

935.short: Power Slam: once/game, initiating combat, decide before rolling: hit -> +10 damage

936.short: Magic Infusion: action: touch an ally within 1" (or itself) -> their attacks count as magic for the rest of the game

937.short: Painfully Insubstantial: never locked in combat, may always move out freely; cannot be forced into combat unless it allows it; 1 self-damage at the end of every activation

938.short: Animal Charmer: action: animals within 12"/LoS fail Will Roll (TN14) -> no actions on their next activation

939.short: The Will to Live: once/game, would be reduced to 0 Health -> stays at 1 Health instead (later reduced to 0 -> -2 to post-game Survival Roll)

94.short: Scrawny Arms: double the normal Fight/Shoot penalty for carrying a treasure token

940.short: Immune to Elemental Magic Damage: elemental magic damage against it is reduced to 0 (reroll if already Immune to Non-Magic Weapons)

941.short: Animated Skin: once/game, action: create a 6-Health copy soldier with its stats/equipment (non-magic versions of magic gear); cannot cast or use Tricks

942.short: Flaming Bile Stream: shooting attack, 8" range, +2 damage, counts as magic

943.short: Mental Strike: action: mental melee combat vs a target within 6"/LoS, both use Will not Fight, both count as Armour 10, no support bonuses, no step/push back either way

944.short: Flaming Bullrush: once/game, move+attack as one action at +2 Fight/+2 damage, counts as elemental magic; if it wins and has another action, may repeat vs a different figure

945.short: Boom Stick: fixed crossbow that needs no reload turn; cannot be given away/sold; replaced if lost

946.short: Rusting Presence: no heavy armour; its weapons -1 damage (not magic ones); after each melee round it completes, all other figures in it suffer a Decay spell on a random weapon

947.short: Wild Spellcaster: before each game, roll three random spells it may attempt at base CN; counts as a spellcaster, may empower

948.short: Heart-Feaster: reduces a figure to 0 Health in melee -> that figure suffers -1 to its post-game Survival Roll

949.short: Consciousness Leap: reduced to 0 Health -> closest enemy within 6" fails Will Roll (TN18) -> under Mind Control (CN 18) by this figure

95.short: Withered Arm: Crushed Arm permanent injury

950.short: Armoured Ball: +2 Armour, -1 Move; no armour/shield; on activation may roll up for +4 more Armour/-4 more Move (min 2) until its next activation, but cannot shoot/pick up or drop treasure/climb while rolled up

951.short: Crocodile Jaws for Hands: no weapons/shields (never unarmed); +1 Fight; +2 melee damage

952.short: Magical Metabolism: after a game it isn't reduced to 0 Health, roll for one random potion it extrudes

953.short: Never Average: natural 10-11 on any roll -> must reroll and take the second result

954.short: Highly Empowered: gains 5 power/turn: empower Casting/Will Rolls (if spellcaster) or add to melee damage that turn (split freely)

955.short: Extremely Hard to Kill: Survival Table rolls: roll three dice, take the highest

956.short: Extreme Regeneration: regains up to 3 Health every time it activates; Permanent Injury/Badly Wounded Survival results always count as Full Recovery instead

957.short: Shared Pain: takes damage -> pick another figure in LoS: fails Will Roll (TN14) -> takes half that damage (round down); no other figure in LoS -> this figure takes +1 damage instead

958.short: Terrain Destroyer: action: auto-cast Crumble (no roll required)

959.short: Illusionary Self: at game start, treated as under a successfully cast Illusionary Soldier spell (same stats except Health)

96.short: Serpent Tale: -1 Move; no rough-ground movement penalty

960.short: Deal with the Devil: once/game, on any die roll, may roll 5 dice and pick one to use; if 2+ dice match, it's reduced to 0 Health after resolving the roll

961.short: Ablative Scales: cannot wear armour; natural Armour 16, but every time it takes any damage, Armour drops by 1 (min 10)

962.short: Deathmark: a melee attack that would reduce the target to 0 Health or less does +5 damage

963.short: Blinding Quickness: each activation, 11+ on d20 -> +1 action (unless another rule caps it at one)

964.short: Four Arms: may carry 2 shields + a 2-handed weapon/staff together; or a 2-handed weapon/staff + 2 hand weapons together for +1 Fight

965.short: Elemental Reflection: targeted by an elemental shooting attack -> may redirect it to any figure in LoS (decide before rolling)

966.short: Stonegaze: action: auto-cast Petrify at Casting Roll 14 vs a target within 6"

967.short: Incredibly Quick: always activates first each turn regardless of phase (roll off vs others with this ability); may never group activate

968.short: Mystic Shield: action: Elemental Shield spell effect

969.short: Partial Immunity to Normal Weapons: half damage (round down) from non-magical attacks

970.short: Elemental Charge: action: charge its own weapon as Elemental Hammer

971.short: Mind Infestation: melee damage dealt -> target treated as hit by Mind Control (CN 14) from this figure (ignored if immune)

972.short: Nearly Immortal: always may reroll any "Dead" Survival result; each time it does, permanent -3 Will/-2 Health and -5 levels (if leveled)

973.short: Far Teleportation: action (usable in combat): teleport d20" in a random direction

974.short: Stormborn: takes 1+ damage -> auto-casts Call Storm (no roll/action)

975.short: Second Chance: first "Dead" Survival result -> treat as Full Recovery instead

977.short: Stunning Beauty: permanent Beauty spell effect at CN 18 (not a spell, cannot be dispelled)

978.short: Body of Flame: cannot wear armour; melee attacks count as elemental magic, +2 damage; anyone forcing combat with it suffers 2 elemental magic damage

979.short: Tornado Spin: action (usable in combat): all within 6" fail Move Roll (TN16) -> pushed away and damaged by the amount failed by

98.short: Three-Arms with Claws: 2-handed weapon/staff + shield together; no unarmed damage penalty

980.short: Psychic Death Shriek: reduced to 0 Health -> every figure on the table fails a Will Roll (TN14) -> damage equal to the amount failed by

982.short: Invisible: cannot be seen or forced into combat unless the viewer can see invisible (figures already in combat still fight); not invisible while carrying treasure

983.short: Raging Attack: one action attacks every figure it's in combat with (separate Combat Rolls, all support bonuses apply, its choice of order)

984.short: Inherent Magic: may attempt any rulebook spell, succeeds only on a natural 20 (may empower normally); counts as a spellcaster

985.short: Mind-Stealer: damages another in melee -> Will Roll (TN16) or becomes a temporary member of its warband (may re-roll to break free at end of each activation; Mind Lock/Immune to Mind Control are immune)

986.short: Restructure Body: each activation, choose one of Amphibious/Expert Climber/Immune to Poison/Never Wounded until its next activation

987.short: Immune to Normal Weapons: can only be hurt by magical weapons or magical spell effects

988.short: Partially Insubstantial: never locked in combat, may always move out freely; cannot be forced into combat unless it allows it

989.short: Miracle Wielder: after each game (and its Survival Roll if any), 11+ on d20 -> heal one permanent injury on any warband member (itself included); 15+ -> revive a figure killed last game to full Health

990.short: Immortal: always may reroll any "Dead" Survival result; each time it does, permanent -2 Will and -2 levels (if leveled)

991.short: Greased Lightning: 3 actions per activation as standard

992.short: Mirror Image: projects a duplicate image adjacent; shooting attacks vs it: 1-10 on d20 -> hits the image instead (auto-miss)

993.short: Elemental Blast: action: +8 elemental magic shooting attack, 3" range

994.short: Force Bubble: action: +10 shooting attack vs all in LoS, pushed away that many inches instead of taking damage (stops at terrain over 1" high)

996.short: Reform: once/game, not in combat: action: return to its original starting Health

997.short: Celerity: activates twice per turn (end of Wizard Phase and end of Soldier Phase, unless one is already its normal phase); still gets its normal number of actions each time

998.short: Life Drain: double melee damage vs living targets (not undead/constructs)
